promptText:
Gemini 4 Argon测“鹈鹕骑车”怎么样？

我干脆开了三个完全空白的会话做了一次裸 Prompt 盲测，顺手还加了一道“秦始皇骑北极熊”😂

以前拿这类题测模型，基本只能画出一堆散架的几何色块，腿脚和踏板永远是脱节穿模的。

这次跑完三个盲测，看明白 Argon 为什么效果稳了：

默认用双连杆逆运动学（2-Bone IK）替代手写关键帧
哪怕 Prompt 里一个字没提物理和骨骼，它也会默认在代码里写一段余弦定理解算器。

每一帧根据曲柄角度实时反推膝盖坐标，把脚掌死死锁在踏板圆周上，甚至还会主动留一个「IK 骨骼透视」开关用来验收。

自带微物理反馈与场景状态机
第一段鹈鹕给了柔性喉囊物理和颠鱼互动；

"Build a complete, playable roguelike deck-builder as ONE self-contained HTML file · no external assets, no CDN, everything inline (CSS, JS, SVG art).

- Juice: floating damage numbers, card-play animations, screen shake, hover previews

Write the whole file to deckbuilder.html, then verify it actually renders — open it in a headless browser, take a screenshot, and fix whatever's broken. Go deep, not broad."

Both delivered a full, playable game. I drove both in headless Chrome, parsed the data tables, and measured the builds side by side:

Cards (60+ required)     Argon 72  ·  SWE-2 93
Enemies (15+ required)   Argon 19  ·  SWE-2 30
Multi-phase bosses       Argon 3   ·  SWE-2 3
Relics / potions         Argon 18/12  ·  SWE-2 25/8
Lines of code            Argon 4,701  ·  SWE-2 1,555
File size                Argon 183KB  ·  SWE-2 110KB
Boot to render           Argon 34ms  ·  SWE-2 24ms
DOM nodes at boot        Argon 218  ·  SWE-2 17
JS heap                  ~9.5MB both

⚔️ THE DIFFERENCE

Argon invented three original class mechanics: a Cinderblade juggling Heat and Burn, a Chronoweaver banking Flux for Time Surges, a Plague Alchemist brewing Reagents into poison chains. 15-floor spire, event modals, campfires. More code, more bespoke systems, more juice.

Argon went deeper — invented mechanics, denser systems, more polish per element.
SWE-2 went broader — more content, less code, proven archetypes.

60% of the file size. 3x the content count. That's the efficiency story.

Both shipped a real game in one file. The honest answer to "which is better" is: what do you value ?
mechanical novelty, or content density per line of code?

The second thing is a .agents/skills folder in your repo: one short SKILL.md that sends the agent to a separate file for each house rule.

STOP RETYPING PROMPTS INTO GEMINI 4. SAVE THESE 5 AS SKILLS

2. /thread-to-reply
"Read this thread, Brain/voice and Brain/rules. Check dates and amounts against the latest message. Draft the reply in Brain/out and link the thread. Send nothing."

-> a reply with your openings, your length and your sign-off, waiting for your yes

3. /idea-to-post
"Turn this line from my notes into a post. Read Brain/voice and Brain/rules first. Use only facts from Brain, each linked. Save the draft to Brain/out."

-> one line from your notes becomes a draft in your voice

4. /fix-rule
"I'm correcting you. Find why it happened, write the fix as one line in Brain/rules and show me the line."

-> the same mistake stops coming back, because every task reads rules first

5. /what-did-i-forget
"Read the whole Brain folder. Write me a page in Brain/out: what changed this week, what is drifting, what I decided and forgot, and docs that duplicate or contradict each other. Report only, change nothing."

-> decisions you made and dropped come back before they cost you

save them in Gemini under Customize, then Skills. names go lowercase with hyphens. type / in any chat or task and they show up
